facts.fact: UNDP reports that in April-June 2025 the Nzika App, a tablet-based integrated registration application, had been tested by the NRB team and not yet deployed, with a pilot in Lilongwe district set for July 2025, four further districts (Karonga, Mchinji, Balaka, Mwanza) from August 2025 and 200 tablets planned for Traditional Authorities.

UNDP reports that each component of the Nzika App, including birth, death and marriage registration alongside national ID, had been tested by the NRB team by June 2025, the app working online and offline on tablets for use in rural and remote areas.

UNDP reports that the Nzika App, its tablets and the health-facility certificate printers are developed and procured by the IDT4M project, a basket-funded UNDP project running March 2024 to February 2028 whose digital ID and CRVS output had a 2025 budget of USD 2.08 million, of which USD 1.45 million was spent by the end of June 2025.

UNDP reports that NRB registered 219,286 births (111,482 male, 107,804 female) and 10,189 deaths across the country in the second quarter of 2025, the NRB system automatically flagging death records that match a national ID number.
